idea-plugin.name: Agent Watch
idea-plugin.description:
Companion to Agent Watch, a macOS app that shows what your Claude Code and Codex sessions are doing. On its own this plugin does nothing.

When you press a session's focus button in Agent Watch, this plugin selects the terminal tab where that session is running, in both the classic and the reworked terminal. The app reaches it through a jetbrains:// link that names the agent's process.

No network, no ports. The plugin writes one small file into Agent Watch's own folder so the app can confirm the plugin is installed: the token it was asked with, the plugin version and the IDE build.

Get Agent Watch: github.com/glockbender/agentwatcher
idea-plugin.change-notes: First version on JetBrains Marketplace. Finds the tab in both the classic and the reworked terminal, and answers the widget's installation check.
